reason: My regulars and Google reviews already keep the chairs full, and when I have an offer I just drop it in the local WhatsApp group. I've never needed Instagram or creators, so I don't see why I'd start paying for it now, even with a free month.
objection: I already get creators asking for freebies every week, and I don't want an AI posting things in my name or sending me random influencers. Plus someone still has to shoot the clips and keep approving, and my staff are busy with clients.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon or gym owner I know in my area showing me real new bookings that came from it in the first month, not just views and followers.
